description: A 1 MiB trigger is longer than the kernel takes for one environment entry: the hook cannot be started (E2BIG), which is logged as exit 126, and the one-shot still exits 0.
departure: Today proc_open() fails to start the shell, and pfb_script_output_exec() reports that as -1. Today pfb_logger() stamps each line it starts on the console with the date and time, as in the main log; the one-shot copies the main log unstamped.

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_a.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 126 ]; continuing
expect.console:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_a.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 126 ]; continuing

old_expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_a.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ -1 ]; continuing
old_expect.console:
{stamp} [ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_a.sh, timeout 60s)
{stamp} [ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ -1 ]; continuing
